title: Delete one file of three in the Files app

setup.why: A fresh folder for this run in Download with three files: the one to delete and two to keep, named alike.

argv: d=/sdcard/Download/computer-bench-{{nonce}}; rm -rf $d && mkdir -p $d && for n in {{f.del}} {{f.k1}} {{f.k2}}; do echo "$n {{nonce}}" > $d/$n-{{nonce}}.txt || exit 1; done

setup.why: Open the system file manager (DocumentsUI) on the folder.

instruction: In the Files app, delete {{f.del}}-{{nonce}}.txt from Download/computer-bench-{{nonce}}. Keep the other files.

checks.why: The folder lists exactly the two kept files. A file a files app sent to the trash is renamed to a hidden .trashed- name, which `ls` doesn't list, so trashing counts as deleted. After setup all three are listed, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Delete the run's folder and everything in it, trashed files included.
